constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof(catch_rule) = 'object'::text) AND (catch_rule ?& ARRAY['version'::text, 'success_bp'::text, 'common_bp'::text, 'rare_bp'::text, 'epic_bp'::text, 'mythic_bp'::text, 'kind'::text, 'trash_bp'::text, 'discovery_weight'::text, 'home_multiplier'::text]) AND (((catch_rule ->> 'version'::text))::integer = 2) AND ((((catch_rule ->> 'success_bp'::text))::integer >= 0) AND (((catch_rule ->> 'success_bp'::text))::integer <= 10000)) AND ((((catch_rule ->> 'common_bp'::text))::integer >= 0) AND (((catch_rule ->> 'common_bp'::text))::integer <= 10000)) AND ((((catch_rule ->> 'rare_bp'::text))::integer >= 0) AND (((catch_rule ->> 'rare_bp'::text))::integer <= 10000)) AND ((((catch_rule ->> 'epic_bp'::text))::integer >= 0) AND (((catch_rule ->> 'epic_bp'::text))::integer <= 10000)) AND ((((catch_rule ->> 'mythic_bp'::text))::integer >= 0) AND (((catch_rule ->> 'mythic_bp'::text))::integer <= 10000)) AND ((((((catch_rule ->> 'common_bp'::text))::integer + ((catch_rule ->> 'rare_bp'::text))::integer) + ((catch_rule ->> 'epic_bp'::text))::integer) + ((catch_rule ->> 'mythic_bp'::text))::integer) = 10000) AND ((catch_rule ->> 'kind'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['mixed'::text, 'trash_weighted'::text, 'decoration'::text, 'discovery_weighted'::text])) AND ((((catch_rule ->> 'trash_bp'::text))::integer >= 0) AND (((catch_rule ->> 'trash_bp'::text))::integer <= 10000)) AND (((catch_rule ->> 'discovery_weight'::text))::numeric >= (1)::numeric) AND (((catch_rule ->> 'home_multiplier'::text))::numeric > (0)::numeric)), false))
CHECK (((fishing_count_max IS NULL) OR ((fishing_count_max >= fishing_count) AND (fishing_count_max <= 100))))
